'''Shaedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to bring supplies to [[Darvannis]] at around [[3638 BBY]]. However, the Kaleesh was caught by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] and was subsequently brought to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Varnus Orlec]] upon the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''. Orlec managed to have Shaedo leak information in exchange for a pardon and a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]], thus learning everything the Kaleesh knew about [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] activities on Darvannis.<ref name="TOR ROTHC" />
